dependency_graph.common_rule: DALI is single-master per bus: control device emits 16-bit forward frame; addressed control gear acts and (for queries) answers with 8-bit backward frame 7..22 TE later. No NACK and no per-frame ACK. Forward frames spaced ≥ 22 TE.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: DATA_BYTE meaning is dispatched by B bit of ADDRESS_BYTE. Backward DATA_BYTE depends on originating QUERY. STORE DTR AS X commands consume most recent DTR loaded by special command 0xA3.

fields.protocol_layer: Application + Data-link layer for a 2-wire DC bus. Manchester-encoded NRZ-equivalent at 1200 baud.

channels_forward_frame.name: ADDRESS_BYTE
channels_forward_frame.purpose: YAAAAAAB. Y address mode, AAAAAA index, B payload type.

channels_forward_frame.name: STOP_FIELD
channels_forward_frame.purpose: Two stop bits HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.

channels_address_byte_decoded.name: ADDRESS_FIELD_AAAAAA
channels_address_byte_decoded.purpose: Short address index or group/broadcast/special index.

channels_physical_options.name: DALI 2-wire DC bus (DA+/DA-)
channels_physical_options.use: Standard DALI universe — 11.5..22.5 V DC, ≤ 250 mA.

channels_physical_options.name: Opto-isolator pair (4N137-class)
channels_physical_options.use: Galvanic isolation between bus and MCU.

channels_physical_options.name: Timer PWM (PWM1/PWM2)
channels_physical_options.use: 1.6 kHz PWM to TPS62260 buck EN.

ordering_rules.frame_ordering: Address byte first, then data byte; MSB first within each byte.
ordering_rules.te_ordering: Within a Manchester bit cell, first half holds leading level; mid-bit transition encodes bit value.
ordering_rules.two_strike_window: ≤ 100 ms between two deliveries of destructive command.
